content: AppIntents App Shortcuts: define struct conforming to AppShortcutsProvider with @AppShortcutsBuilder static appShortcuts; AppShortcut(intent:phrases:shortTitle:systemImageName:) with AppShortcutPhrase like "Search YouTube for \(.applicationName)" plus parameter token for the query. Available iOS 16.0+. Zero-setup: available on install without user registration; phrases extracted at compile time by metadata extraction.
